purpose: Apply a model trained on development handoff to 2025 panel and evaluate under the unified execution protocol.
feature_rule: use every feature_name row; same 92 inputs as development
model_source: Train only on training_handoff (development through 2024). Do not refit hyperparameters on 2025.
label_rule: signal at T close; hold the mapped actual contract from T+1 open to T+h+1 open; suspected locked entry/exit is excluded
notes: ml_features_2025 has no NaNs in feature columns after upstream processing.
Drop rows where future_return_5d is missing or entry/exit execution flags fail before portfolio evaluation.
Signal at T close, trade at T+1 open, 5-day hold, rebalance every 5 days, top/bottom 20%, equal weight within side, 5 bps one-way base cost.
